visual_review.status: curation inspection complete; root acceptance pending
visual_review.method: view_image inspection of all six source screens, two swatch sheets and three selected source/palette comparison sheets. RGB still/frame0 color review only; no native renderer, no image-generation tool, no claim of colorimetric calibration or accessibility compliance.

duplicate_review.metric_limit: Nearest-color Oklab distance is a screening aid. It ignores ordering, coverage and accent role and is not an acceptance threshold.
curated_distinctions: Deep Teal keeps a dark teal ground; Jade Frost spans blue-green structure and a white ground.
Blue Linen is warm paper plus medium denim; Frost Slate adds near-black slate and pale cool blue.
Glacier Mist is restrained cyan-gray; Seafoam Sand alternates turquoise and sandy warm hues.
Wine Ash has dark red anchors; Pearl Wine has mostly desaturated warm neutrals.
Rose Slate balances cool blue and pink; Mauve Mist stays within a subdued mauve neutral range.
Slate Pearl uses chromatic blue-gray and green-gray shadows; Ink & Ivory is nearly achromatic with a warmer paper endpoint.
Sage Linen is a muted olive ramp; Olive Bone includes a sharper yellow-green accent and a near-white ground.
Copper Blush emphasizes warm brown and rose highlights; Pearl Wine emphasizes desaturated gray with wine shadows.
Dusty Rose Sage pairs rose with green-gray; Coral Slate moves toward peach with a cool gray anchor.

coverage.selection_basis: Hue relationships, usable value spans, dark/light grounds and restrained versus saturated options. No artist allocation or quota; 50 distinct source artworks across 9 artists survived visual selection.
